executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in at least one AI answer for 100% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared 71.7% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa in the hotel options surfaced.

Celebrations & Events is Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa's clearest competitive strength. The hotel appeared in 77.5% of AI answers for these searches, compared with 12.5% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis — about 6.2 times as often as the comparable hotels used in this analysis. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in the Top 3 35.6% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
